_comment: Sprite sheet of ВОСТОК-9. One entry per PNG in content/art/. Ids are file names without the extension; the game looks them up through content/art/index.json, which generate.mjs writes. Order is priority order — the generator walks the list top to bottom and stops cleanly when the key runs out of generations, so the cells (70% of the screen) are always paid for first. Every `size` here is the size the sprite is DRAWN at in design pixels, or an exact whole fraction of it: NEAREST scaling by 1.203 duplicates rows unevenly and scaling by 0.875 throws four rows out of thirty-two. Nothing is tiled any more — `button-face` was, and its tile had a seam, so it is gone; anything tiled in future must be a power of two on both sides as well. Sides must also be divisible by four: the API answers «422 Canvas width and height must both be divisible by 4» otherwise. tests/art.test.ts holds every one of those sums against src/game/layout.ts.

style._comment: One style for every asset: a mixed set of sprites looks worse than honest rectangles. Do not vary these per asset.

palettes._comment: GDD_VOSTOK9.md §16, one group per layer plus the surface, the machines and the polar night. Every request sends the group as a forced palette (color_image), which is what keeps the set together — and which is why a prompt may never ask for a colour its own group does not hold: the generator physically cannot paint it. The other half of that lever is what a group leaves OUT: `plate` and `steel` have no near-white in them because with #E8EDF2 on the list the generator painted a specular cloud across the middle of every flat plate, and the middle of a plate is where the interface writes. tests/art.test.ts checks every colour against §16.

assets._note: Четыре генерации (сиды 19941/19946/19947/19948) просили пятна, разводы и линовку — все четыре пришли ровным цветом: при форсированной палитре низкоконтрастный узор схлопывается в фон. Промпт приведён к тому, что файл содержит на самом деле. Сетка, сгибы и линовка рисуются кодом в formLayout.sheetRuling — детерминированно и бесплатно. Если однажды захочется фактуры, пробовать надо контрастную формулировку («bold dark ruled lines»), как у пород, а не ещё один сид к «faint».
